fit: Parkinson perfusion and visual reasoning comparison
assessment: The study compared 28 nondemented Parkinson participants with 17 controls. It correlated right visual-association-area perfusion with a visual reasoning score. The abstract reports no separately coded visual event frequency or measured fig exposure.

The 601 assessed participants included 20 probable and 10 possible dementia with Lewy bodies cases. A diagnostic prevalence is not a within-person visual event rate. Full symptom coding remains pending.
